intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season, late booking dan surcaj travel 2027 dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Kadar transport ikut kawasan dan kelas kenderaan (Avanza / Innova 2–4 pax, Van 8 Seater 5–8 pax, Van 16 Seater 9–16 pax) — pilih blok itinerary supaya kos berlabuh pada kawasan yang betul. Kadar accommodation ialah per pax per malam ikut hotel dan jenis bilik, dan ada kadar peak sendiri. Pilihan bertanda dalam pakej = RM 0 supaya tiada double-count dengan harga katalog.

validity: Validity of Quotation: Prices are based on the PT Sabah 3D2N and 4D3N 3-Star catalogues version 3, last updated 1 July 2026 and valid until 31 December 2026. This quotation is valid for 24 hours from the date of issue and is subject to hotel and room availability, as no space has been secured. Prices are for 2 to 3 persons per room; single supplement is RM 300 per person for the 3D2N package and RM 450 per person for the 4D3N package. A deposit of RM 250 per person is due on confirmation and full payment 30 days before departure. A late booking surcharge of RM 50 per booking applies to bookings made less than 45 days before departure. Departures between 1 January and 30 June 2027 carry a travel date surcharge of RM 100 per person. The driver cum guide is Malay speaking and works on a 12 hours basis per day; luggage is limited to one piece per person because of vehicle capacity. The final itinerary and hotel arrangements are shared 14 days before the trip and remain subject to change due to weather, traffic, safety or operational conditions. Entrance fees, tourism tax and surcharges for non-Malaysian passport holders, normally around RM 170 to RM 370 per person, are excluded and payable directly during the trip. Free activities are not exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if the client does not join, or where availability or weather prevents them.
